name: get_full_system_config
description: Get the full system configuration: subsystem states (INSTEON/Z-Wave/Zigbee/Matter enabled/connected), PLM info, OS/network/USB info, and available upgrades. No params. Free-standing -- callable any time, including while a PLM-exclusive diagnostic tool (get_dev_links_table/compare_device_links/get_all_plm_links/quick_plm_sanity_check) is running.
